lines: The race's world now has riders in it: everyone you race, drawn where they are on the route.
Race the bots, and each one rides in view in its own jersey colour, the same colour as its dot on the standings.
Race solo, and your best ride comes back as a ghost: your shape on a bike, in translucent gold, beside you.
Each rider keeps a line of its own across the road, cuts to the inside of a bend, and leans into it.
Every rider is main's cyclist kit, the same bike and rider you ride. main had no ghost, so it is drawn new from the kit, in its style.
From a phone to a desktop, the field rides ahead of you on the road.
What the tests prove: the renderer reports the riders it drew, in their jersey colours, at their places, and the ghost translucent gold. No pixel is read.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
